title: 第22章 那场面，堪比爱情动作片啊！
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李大壮脑子里“轰隆”一声，理智的弦好像都被徐晴这一句话给弄断了，浑身燥热难耐，恨不能立刻把徐晴推倒在那张小床上，狠狠的……

    可他终于还是忍住了：“徐小姐，请自重，咱们才刚认识……”

    “大壮！你嫌我不自重！？”

    徐晴很受伤，雪白娇躯又轻轻颤抖起来，水眸委屈的瞪着李大壮：“我告诉你，我徐晴长这么大，还没跟男人做过这种事儿呢！就算是我以前的男朋友，也只牵过我的手，嘴都没给他亲过！”

    “想把自己给你，就是因为看中你这个人了！就算我们刚认识又怎么样？我一眼就能看出你是个靠得住的好男人！”

    “我告诉你，姐这些年生意可不是白做的，看人的眼力还是有的，吴家那哥俩我也早就看出是猥琐之辈了，也怪我老想着我在清水镇没人脉，万一有人来闹事，他俩在执法所的关系能用的上。”

    “没想到却是搬起石头砸了自己的脚！”

    “总之，我真不是随便的人！”徐晴急的了不得，身前那两座雪峰，也不消停的随之摇晃，一双玉手紧紧抓着李大壮粗壮的胳膊，雪白的肤色和你大壮的古铜色肌肤贴在一起，冲击感十足！

    李大壮连忙说：“徐小姐我相信你，我能闻出来，你的体香很纯，确实是没经历过男女之事的味道！”

    “啊？你连这都能闻出来！？”徐晴惊讶的张大了嘴巴。

    李大壮正要点头，却忽然耳朵一动，连忙道：“徐小姐，快把衣服穿好，那俩家伙好像又带人来了！”

    “啊！你怎么知道！？”徐晴的嘴巴张的更大了！

    “我的听力也比一般人好，听见楼下有急刹车的声音，还有那俩人穿衣服的声音，现在他们已经走进一楼了！”

    虽然徐晴啥也没听见，但看李大壮严肃的表情，莫名生出一股信任，连忙把包里的防晒衣拿出来穿上，雪白瞬间被遮住，只露出紧身裙下的修长美腿！

    徐晴的衣服刚穿好，房间门就被人从外面踹开，只见三个穿着执法服的男人，面色严肃的大步朝房间里走来，中间那个大腹便便，脸色更加阴沉，身边还站着俩熟悉的猥琐面孔，正是刚被李大壮打跑的吴大皮和吴二皮！

    不过这会儿俩人已换上一副嚣张模样，指着李大壮对那大腹便便的执法者说：“叔，就是这小子！他先强女干我们老板娘，被我撞见，就打伤我俩，您快把他抓牢里去，让他们赔我俩医药费！”
content_en:
There was a "bang" in Li Dazhuang's mind, and his rational mind seemed to be broken by Xu Qing's words. His whole body was unbearably hot, and he wished he could push Xu Qing down on the small bed immediately, and fiercely...

    But he finally held back: "Miss Xu, please respect yourself, we just met..."

    "Da Zhuang! Do you think I don't respect myself!?"

    Xu Qing was very hurt, and her snow-white body trembled slightly again. She stared at Li Dazhuang with aggrieved eyes: "I tell you, in my whole life, Xu Qing, I have never done this kind of thing with a man! Even my previous boyfriend only held my hand and never kissed him!"

    "I want to give myself to you just because I like you! So what if we just met? I can tell at a glance that you are a reliable and good man!"

    "Let me tell you, my business has not been in vain these years. I still have a good eye for people. I have long seen that the two brothers from the Wu family are wretched people. It is also my fault that I always think that I have no connections in Qingshui Town. If someone comes to cause trouble, their relationship in the law enforcement office can be used."

    "I didn't expect that I shot myself in the foot!"

    "Anyway, I'm really not a casual person!" Xu Qing was extremely anxious. The two snow peaks in front of her were shaking non-stop. A pair of jade hands tightly grasped Li Dazhuang's thick arms. The snow-white skin and your strong bronze skin stuck together, which was full of impact!

    Li Dazhuang said quickly: "Miss Xu, I believe you. I can smell it. Your body fragrance is very pure. It is indeed the scent of someone who has never experienced anything between a man and a woman!"

    "Ah? You can even smell this!?" Xu Qing opened her mouth in surprise.

    Li Dazhuang was about to nod, but suddenly his ears twitched and he said quickly: "Miss Xu, put your clothes on quickly, those two guys seem to have brought someone here again!"

    "Ah! How did you know!?" Xu Qing's mouth opened even wider!

    "My hearing is also better than the average person. I heard the sound of a sudden brake downstairs and the sound of the two people getting dressed. Now they have entered the first floor!"

    Although Xu Qing didn't hear anything, looking at Li Dazhuang's serious expression, she felt an inexplicable sense of trust. She quickly took out the sun protection clothing from her bag and put it on. The white snow was instantly covered, only revealing her slender legs under the tight skirt!

    As soon as Xu Qing put on her clothes, the door to the room was kicked open from the outside, and she saw three men in law enforcement uniforms, striding towards the room with serious faces. The one in the middle had a big belly and a gloomier face. There were two familiar wretched faces standing beside him. They were Wu Dapi and Wu Erpi who had just been beaten away by Li Dazhuang!

    But now the two of them had put on an arrogant look, pointing at Li Dazhuang and saying to the pot-bellied law enforcer: "Uncle, it's this kid! He first forced a woman to fuck our boss's wife, and when I caught him, he injured both of us. Please catch him quickly and let them pay for our medical expenses!"
title_en: Chapter 22 That scene is comparable to a love action movie!
